command: set -euo pipefail; LA="$HOME/local-agent"; test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main; test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = '140f78d83f95dc2fde74bd3a69b7330d6b10803b'; git -C "$LA" fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse origin/main)" = '140f78d83f95dc2fde74bd3a69b7330d6b10803b'; cd "$LA"; test "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal | awk '{print $2}' | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'README.md agent_version.py docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.11.4.md '; grep -Fq 'RELEASE_VERSION = "4.11.4"' agent_version.py; grep -Fq '**Current release:** `v4.11.4`' README.md; grep -Fq 'ESP32-C6 Zigbee (`esp32-c6-zigbee`)' docs/OPERATIONS.md; test -f docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.11.4.md; git diff --check; env -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_FDS -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_KEYS_DIGEST .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -q; git add -- README.md agent_version.py docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.11.4.md; git diff --cached --check; test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'README.md agent_version.py docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.11.4.md '; git commit -m 'Align downstream documentation for v4.11.4'; git push origin HEAD:main; SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | cut -f1)" = "$SHA"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; echo CANDIDATE_SHA=$SHA
